name: kairos-canvas-mcp
description: Local-first student Canvas client — read your courses and plan your week. It never submits or posts for you.
long_description: Kairos Canvas MCP is a local-first, student-only server (~40 tools) for Canvas LMS: courses, assignments, discussions, modules, files, and messaging. It runs as a stdio MCP server using your Canvas API token and/or SSO sync — every read runs under your own Canvas role and audit trail. Anything on the other side of a submit, a comment, or a discussion post is preview-only and has no execution path: Kairos shows you what would be sent and you send it yourself. Exams, proctored tools, and LTI submits stay human-only.

canvas_api_url.title: Canvas API URL
canvas_api_url.description: Your institution's Canvas base URL, e.g. https://canvas.example.edu

canvas_api_token.title: Canvas API Token
canvas_api_token.description: A Canvas personal access token (Account → Settings → New Access Token). Stored securely in your OS keychain. Optional when using SSO sync.
